objective: Keep project detail state addressable, improve overview hierarchy, and preserve labels in edit selectors.
decisions: Use the existing Vue Router history route /projects/:projectId as the source of selected project state.
Move the existing calendar card into a two-column upper summary section; reuse the existing calendar markup and theme variables.
Await the existing user option loader before opening edit dialogs so Element Plus can resolve IDs to labels.
Increase only the plan number table column width; keep the existing responsive horizontal table behavior.

approval.evidence: user requested the four frontend corrections
